title: All Tied Up
statementMd:
FIFA is organizing a football tournament with a group stage. One group contains $n$ national teams, numbered from $1$ to $n$. Each pair of teams in the group will play exactly once.

A win awards $3$ points to the winning team and $0$ to the losing team. A draw awards $1$ point to each team.

Your friend Pedro claims that this group will be so evenly matched that all $n$ teams will finish the group stage tied on exactly $k$ points. You want to find out whether this is possible.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/470446d9e87c052354f95f73fe9961dd71a003a5.png)*"Stoppage time: until they equalize!"*

Given $n$ and $k$, determine whether results can be assigned to the $\frac{n(n-1)}{2}$ matches so that every team finishes with exactly $k$ points. If so, print any set of results that demonstrates this.

## Input

The input consists of a single line containing two integers $n$ and $k$ ($3 \leq n \leq 500$, $0 \leq k \leq 3n-3$), the number of teams and the desired final score of each team, respectively.

## Output

If it is impossible for every team to finish with exactly $k$ points, print `-1` on a single line.

Otherwise, print exactly $\frac{n(n-1)}{2}$ lines, one per match. Each line must have the form $a\ s\ b$, where $a$ and $b$ ($1 \leq a,b \leq n$, $a \neq b$) are teams and $s$ is one of the symbols $ \gt $, $=$, or $ \lt $.

Each pair of teams must appear on exactly one line. The symbols mean:

- $ \gt $: team $a$ beat team $b$;
- $ \lt $: team $a$ lost to team $b$;
- $=$: the match ended in a draw.

You may print the matches in any order. If several valid answers exist, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
FIFA 正在组织一场设有小组赛阶段的足球锦标赛。某个小组中有 $n$ 支国家队，编号为 $1$ 到 $n$。组内每两支球队之间恰好进行一场比赛。

每场比赛中，获胜的球队获得 $3$ 分，落败的球队获得 $0$ 分。如果比赛以平局结束，则双方各获得 $1$ 分。

你的朋友 Pedro 声称，这个小组的各支球队实力十分接近，以至于全部 $n$ 支球队在小组赛结束时都会恰好积 $k$ 分。你想判断这是否可能。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/470446d9e87c052354f95f73fe9961dd71a003a5.png)*“伤停补时：直到他们扳平比分为止！”*

给定 $n$ 和 $k$，判断能否为这 $\frac{n(n-1)}{2}$ 场比赛安排结果，使每支球队最终都恰好积 $k$ 分。如果可以，输出任意一组满足要求的比赛结果。

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $k$（$3≤n≤500$，$0≤k≤3n−3$），分别表示球队数量和每支球队期望的最终积分。

## 输出格式

如果无法使每支球队最终都恰好积 $k$ 分，在单独一行中输出 `-1`。

否则，输出恰好 $\frac{n(n-1)}{2}$ 行，每行对应一场比赛。每行的格式必须为 $a\ s\ b$，其中 $a$ 和 $b$（$1≤a,b≤n$，$a≠b$）表示两支球队，$s$ 为符号 >>、== 或 << 之一。

每一对球队必须恰好出现在一行中。这些符号的含义如下：

- >>：球队 $a$ 战胜了球队 $b$；
- <<：球队 $a$ 输给了球队 $b$；
- ==：比赛以平局结束。

你可以按任意顺序输出比赛。如果存在多组合法答案，输出任意一组即可。
